sections.title: Sign-up handler
sections.what: Checks the registration body, creates the account through the auth service, and returns a success message with the new user.
sections.why: Likely reason: the client address is passed on so the service can limit or flag sign-ups from the same source.
sections.watch_out: The returned user object must not include secret fields such as password data, and the service is responsible for that.

summary: Creates a new account from a registration body and returns the new user.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond creating an account; the client IP is passed for the service to use.
how: 1) Checks the registration body against its schema. 2) Passes the details and the client's address to the register service. 3) Returns a message and the new user with status 201.
inputs: A POST with a JSON registration body and the request headers for the client address.
outputs: A JSON message and the new user with status 201.
risks: The full user object from the service is returned, so the service must leave out sensitive fields.
debug: If sign-up fails, check the registration schema and the register function in the auth service.
